name: Topsy-Turvy
description: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Bounced back to the original user by Magic Coat or the Ability Magic Bounce.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
The move plays its animation when used on an ally.
